evidence.reason: In `run_case`, `mutated_files` is captured before the CLI call, but the post-CLI file state is never captured or compared. `cleanup()` runs before the assertions and restores the unsafe-metadata fixture mode, so a controller write on the refusal path (e.g. changing `0666` to `0600`) is masked by the later baseline/file comparison. This is an ordinary test-verification bug; the negative control should observe fixture files before cleanup, with cleanup in `finally`.
